Hi Laura,

We just signed up for a trial of Redwood Hosted API via the self-serve flow (company: ShopLoop). I’m Ayesha — head of integrations. What we care about most: tail latency at 128 tokens, throughput at 200 TPS peak, and embedding consistency for deduplication.
